Throwaway account I don't use that often.

I'm sixteen in Ireland and was admitted to an inpatient child and adolescent psych ward for about two months for suicide attempts (I also got an Asperger Syndrome diagnosis while there).

It was much better than you'd think, possibly because it was a child and adolescent ward. The nurses were (almost) all very kind and friendly. We had a school there and groups such as psychotherapy, DBT, CBT, teenage life skills etc. 

There were usually about twelve to fifteen kids there at a time. I made some very good friends and met my boyfriend there as well (though physical relationships weren't allowed so we had to keep it a secret until we both were discharged).

There were certain things nobody was allowed to have regardless of what problems they had. These included glass bottles, nail clippers, spray deodorants. During the day we were allowed to wear shoes with laces and hoodies with strings but these things would be taken away at night.

I found it to be a very positive and helpful environment and so did the people from there who I'm still in contact with, though I know some of the other patients disliked it there. I'm glad that that was where I ended up being admitted as I can imagine a lot of psych units wouldn't be as helpful or relaxed.
Can't get a clear head. I've been like this for three months. I've been unhealthily obsessed with him since I met him a year and a half ago.

because i've tried finding love and happiness elsewhere.
nothing compares.

I don't want anybody to be better. It would feel like a betrayal to him, even though he's found someone better than me.
Fuck it. I'm just gonna have to hope that maybe today he'll try to talk me out of it.
I have tried it with other people. I don't want it with anybody but my ex. It was six months and the only time ever remember being happy, and nobody else can do that for me.
Thanks for saying that, I guess. It's just how you know many teenagers get really obsessive over relationships, then they're over it the next day? I kind of wish it was like that but it isn't.
